title: Progressions: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: In an arithmetic progression the 4th term is 14 and the 10th term is 32. What is the 20th term?
How many terms of 24, 21, 18, ... must be added to get a sum of 78?
The 3rd term of a geometric progression is 12 and the 6th term is 96. What is the first term?
A ball is dropped from a height of 81 m. Each time it hits the ground it rises to 2/3 of the height it fell from. What total distance does it travel before coming to rest?
Two positive numbers have an arithmetic mean of 25 and a geometric mean of 20. What are they?
